purpose: Bounded real-provider requalification of GPT-6 Luna via the Codex channel for the Semantic Assessor SCHEMA_BOUND_TOOL_CALL requirement. Follow-up to round 1 (codex-structured-output-probe-2026-10-04.json: 4 attempts, 0 schema-valid outputs, two channel barriers). This round lands the strict-mode schema reformulation plus the Codex launch-path repair, then certifies on 2/2 schema-valid STACK trials through the AEH production path. The round-1 file is frozen and untouched.

forensics.method: Deterministic audit of outputJsonSchema('semantic-assessment') plus minimal schema-gate calls (schema rejections fail before any model turn, so forensics cost no model turns). Forensics driver: /tmp/aeh-codex-probe (out-of-tree).

failureClasses.classification: channel barrier (Codex strict rejects the zod discriminated-union oneOf emission before any model turn)

failureClasses.error: invalid_request_error 400 invalid_json_schema: In context=('properties', 'judgment', 'anyOf', '3', 'properties', 'versions'), 'propertyNames' is not permitted.
failureClasses.classification: channel barrier (Codex strict rejects the zod record emission for STACK versions: propertyNames plus schema-valued additionalProperties). anyOf itself passed the gate at this point, confirming the OpenAI-documented oneOf->anyOf workaround.

failureClasses.repro: codex exec -m gpt-6-luna -s read-only --output-schema <anyOf schema with versions as strict entries array, all else identical>
failureClasses.error: invalid_request_error 400 invalid_json_schema: In context=('properties', 'judgment', 'anyOf', '7'), 'required' is required to be supplied and to be an array including every key in properties. Missing 'skillOrToolPackSuggestion'.

String/enum/array-bound constraints (minLength, maxLength, minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, const) passed the gate unchallenged.

failureClasses.gate: AEH Paseo provider-catalog preflight (harness-side, found by the first production-path attempt)
failureClasses.error: Paseo provider preflight failed: Model codex/openai/gpt-6-luna is not present in Paseo's current provider catalog. Available models include bare 'gpt-6-luna'.
failureClasses.classification: harness launch-path defect (not a model result): the semantic runner sent the canonical model id where the Codex channel requires the provider-native model name. compilePaseoAgentLaunchSpec already used selection.modelName for codex; the assessor runner now matches it. Fixed in src/semantic/runtime.ts, pinned by tests/semanticAssessmentRuntime.test.ts. The 2 preflight failures are harness misconfiguration, not model capability, and are excluded from the certification trial count.

fix.approach: Single source of truth at the zod schema (wire schema tracks the deterministic validator; no post-processing divergence except the $schema strip): (1) semanticJudgmentSchema z.discriminatedUnion -> z.union, so the exported schema uses anyOf with the same eight const-discriminated variants (disjoint discriminators => accepted language unchanged); (2) STACK versions z.record -> z.array of strict {key,value} entries preserving the trimmed 1..200 bounds, canonicalized to record equivalence (sorted by key, last wins) in normalization and consumed the same way by the stack projector; (3) OPERATIONS_ANALYSIS skillOrToolPackSuggestion .optional() -> .nullable() (explicit null is equivalent to absent; required key satisfies strict); (4) outputJsonSchema strips the zod-emitted $schema dialect marker (missing $schema is valid; deterministic validation unaffected). No keys dropped, no discriminators loosened, no free-text substitute, no encoded strings, no fallback. OpenCode channel untouched (Muse stays uncertified, Luna OpenCode entry stays removed).
fix.schemaNote: Schema bytes/sha differ from round 1 (9413 / 4757b1cf...) for two honest reasons: the strict reformulation above, and zod 4.4.3 toJSONSchema emission (package.json allows ^4.0.17). Round-1 bytes are frozen with round 1.
fix.promptNote: Production SEMANTIC_ASSESSOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT sent natively as systemPrompt through the Paseo SDK (round 1 inlined it as a user-prompt prefix because neither paseo run nor codex exec accepts a system-prompt flag; that deviation is removed on the production path).

method.matrix: STACK assessment x2, each a genuine provider turn (fresh InMemory cache per trial, distinct evidence, cacheDisposition FRESH both times)
method.path: AEH production path: deny-all permissions (read/write/shell/network/delegate/review/validate/gitWrite), codex runtime with structuredOutput capability, openai/gpt-6-luna variant xhigh, paseo transport (SDK), semantic-assessment outputContract, production prompt builder, production SemanticAssessmentServiceV1 gates (zod payload, evidence, binding, provenance). The single documented non-production element is the assessor identity construction, which mirrors resolveSemanticAssessor exactly (same fields, same canonical digest) but bypasses the capability gate being requalified; the turn, parse, and validation path is 100% production code. Certification driver: /tmp/aeh-codex-probe/run-certification.mts (out-of-tree).

summary.conclusion: openai/gpt-6-luna is CERTIFIED at SCHEMA_BOUND_TOOL_CALL via the Codex channel on the strict-reformulated schema: 2/2 schema-valid STACK trials through the AEH production path (Paseo SDK, deny-all, semantic-assessment contract), median 15085ms.
